name: blood_for_bones_returns_one_to_hand
notes: G3 (amount+1 at 1/0/effect/steps/1/args/cards/count). Printed: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature. Return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield, then return another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.' One card to each zone. Seat 0 sacrifices its only creature, the Bear (no choice to make), then returns Fallen A (handle card:2) to the battlefield and Fallen B (card:3) to its hand. Fallen C, the sacrificed Bear and the noncreature Used Instant stay in the graveyard; seat 0's hand holds exactly one card.
